questions.stem: Using the same sets: universal = {1,...,10}, A = {2,4,6,8,10}, B = {3,6,9}. How many elements are in (A ∪ B)'?
questions.explanation: A ∪ B = {2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10} which has 7 elements. (A ∪ B)' = elements NOT in A ∪ B = {1, 5, 7} which has 3 elements.
n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B) = 15 + 20 − 8 = 27. Option (a) forgets to subtract the intersection. This formula prevents double-counting elements that are in both sets.
P(A' ∩ B) = P(B) − P(A ∩ B) = 0.4 − 0.2 = 0.2. This represents the part of B that does NOT overlap with A (the 'B only' region on a Venn diagram).

questions.stem: The shaded region of a Venn diagram represents elements in B but not in A. Which set notation describes this region?
questions.explanation: 'In B but not in A' means in B AND in A'. This is written A' ∩ B. Option (a) gives 'in A but not in B'. Option (c) gives 'not in A or B' (outside both circles). Option (d) gives the overlap.
